method.value: 2-D Gaussian fits to maps; spectrum integrated over pixels above 2 sigma, fit with Gaussian

method.value: Gaussian spectral fit per position with 2-sigma flux cut

evidence.quote: It was made using the AIPS[^2] XGAUS task with 2-$\sigma$ flux cut at each position by Gaussian spectral fit.

analysis_steps.goal: Fit tilted ring model to velocity field

method.value: ROTCUR in GIPSY, five rings width 0.1'' centred 0.15''-0.55''; phi, i fit first, then centre and Vsys; weighted means

evidence.quote: We solve for $V_{c}(R)$ in five concentric rings, each with a width of $0.1\ensuremath{''}$ and central radius from $0.15\ensuremath{''}$ to $0.55\ensuremath{''}$.

key_parameters.value: UNIFORM weighting, exclusion angle 0 deg; only rings >3 sigma used

evidence.quote: Note that only rings with fitting parameter values above 3-$\sigma$ are considered as a successful fit

assumptions.value: Pure circular rotation; shared centre, Vsys, phi, i across rings

evidence.loc: 3.2 Gas Dynamics in the Quasar Host Galaxy
evidence.quote: we simply assume that the gas has a pure circular rotation in a gas disk

fitting.value: Least-squares in ROTCUR; errors are weighted standard deviations

evidence.loc: Discussion, GIPSY modeling of gas dynamics
evidence.quote: The final values of $\phi$ and $i$ are calculated as the weighted mean of each $\phi(R)$ and $i(R)$, and the uncertainties are taken as the weighted standard deviations ($\sigma_{sdv}$) of the fitting parameters

validation.value: Model velocity field (VELFI) and residual map <30 km/s; inclination varied 26-48 deg

evidence.quote: The residual map is shown in the middle panel with velocity difference less than 30 km s$^{-1}$ across the entire velocity field.

analysis_steps.goal: Derive M_dyn, M_BH and mass ratio

method.value: M_dyn from V_c at 3.2 kpc; M_BH from Mg II width and L3000 via Shen & Liu; compare with local ratio from Kormendy & Ho

evidence.quote: The derived $M_{\rm BH}$/$M_{\rm dyn}$ ratio is 0.020, which is about 4 times higher than the present-day $M_{\rm BH}$/$M_{\rm bulge}$ ratio

assumptions.value: Dynamical mass taken as bulge mass for local ratio

evidence.quote: calculated taking our dynamical mass as the bulge mass by Equation 11 in (cite: Ho2013)
